name: arezaeinia-claude-plugins
description: A collection of Claude Code plugins focused on test architecture and code quality for Spring Boot services.

plugins.name: spring-boot-test
plugins.description: Shapes the test architecture, framework conventions, and maintainability patterns for Java and Kotlin Spring Boot services. Applies the Practical Test Pyramid end-to-end: the right test type for each class, consistent structure across the codebase, and conventions that keep the suite easy to maintain as it grows. Includes skills for both Kotlin (Kotest+MockK or JUnit5+Mockito) and Java (JUnit5+Mockito+AssertJ). Stack: Spring Boot 3.4+, TestContainers, WireMock.
